Karina reached the hospital in time. Her baby was born safely, and she had no complications.

Starlink brought specialist medical guidance into a home far from the city and helped a mother get urgent care.

This is why Starlink matters. It connects people to help when lives are at stake.

This lifesaving technology should be available in every part of the world.

It also leads across key cybersecurity evaluations scoring 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for finding vulnerabilities, 54.8% on ExploitGym for exploitation, and 71.0% on CWE-bench for patching.

We’re seeing significant improvements in long-horizon tasks even compared to Argon, and we’ve strengthened frontier safeguards.

As we did with Argon, we’re going to roll it out gradually + responsibly. Some trusted cyber defenders will get access starting this week. We'll be expanding it to more partners through our Fairwind Program, ahead of wider availability soon, so hang tight!
